qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the staged candidate tree c4b6d94 and serialized fix rechecks of the revised tree d9a9765, committed signed as b0e6a93, found the original correctness, quiz-safety and comprehensibility defects resolved; scoped coverage, consistency and scoped cross-file integration were clean throughout. 次第 no longer presents actual past occurrence as the rule of the Russian-added comparison た-форма + 途端に: it now says that 途端 stresses the moment when one event is immediately followed by another, often unexpected one, and cites 途端's JMdict entry 1610870 and Bunpro's たとたんに page. お昼, which teaches the daytime sense, now declares a direct exclusion with 昼間 «дневное время», and プラス, which teaches «прибавить» and names 足す as its comparison, declares one with 足す «прибавлять; добавлять». 歓迎 no longer reuses 迎える's Russian «встречать; приветствовать»: its verb gloss is «радушно принимать кого-то или что-то; благосклонно относиться к чему-то», the people example reads «Мы все радушно приняли нового учителя.», and an unlinked sentence (link parity forbids a Russian-only internal link) contrasts 迎える（むかえる）, meeting an arriving person, with 歓迎's warmth of reception. Optional comparison-entry citations were added to 事情, 様, 構成, 検討, 栄養 and 松, each matched to the compared card's own dictionary line. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes, including the staged-tree review while commit signing was unavailable, are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 28 EN exclusions across 14 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 19 direct, one-sided exclusions on 16 new cards: 昼食–昼; お昼–昼間; プラス–足す; 正–正しい; 歓迎–受付; 事情–原因; 次第–流れ/途端; 欠席–休む; 機嫌–気持ち; 横断–渡る/横切る; 様–手段; 構成–組む; 検討–考える/論じる; 栄養–食料品; 板–黒板; 松–松竹梅. お昼–昼間 and プラス–足す were added after review (consistency F1 and F2); the author had not considered them. The author classed 昼食–昼, 事情–原因, 次第–途端, 機嫌–気持ち, 横断–渡る, 横断–横切る, 検討–論じる and 板–黒板 as required and the other nine author pairs as conservative; the consistency reviewer called 欠席–休む and 構成–組む required, the 横断 pairs conservative leaning required, and 正–正しい, 次第–流れ and 松–松竹梅 conservative leaning required, and requested no removal. These differences are preserved, not voted. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 24 relative links across the 16 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions, using EN's href forms: three links in each of the kanji pages 席 and 欠 (to 欠席), 構 (to 構成) and 権 (to 権利); one in the article numbers-and-counters (to 株); and one in each of 11 word cards: 拍手 (to 歓迎), 松竹梅, 梅 and 竹 (to 松), 検査, 考慮 and 見当 (to 検討), 状況 (to 事情), 義務 (to 権利), 遅刻 (to 欠席) and 黒板 (to 板). Mentions that EN leaves unlinked stay plain. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 43 selected 30 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 0 of the 76-batch dependency-closed queue of the general remaining-word pool (30 of 2,277 remaining EN words, recomputed after Batch 203). Its closure under the source quiz-exclusion edges is exactly the 30 requested words; nothing was added. お昼→昼食, 正午→お昼, 正→プラス, 次第→事情 and 機関→エンジン are the dependency edges inside the batch.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped (5 EN link occurrences, 5 targets): 梅雨→kanji 梅; 栄養→kanji 栄; 板→kanji 板; 松→kanji 松; 来→以来. 12 written kanji have no RU kanji card: 嫌, 松, 板, 栄, 株, 桜, 梅, 検, 歓, 第, 討, 養. No RU-only links were added (EN link parity).

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: 正–本当, 来–次 and 横断–越える guards (the consistency reviewer assessed each as low risk; no title or title segment is shared, and EN declares none); re-terming 梅 in 松 and 桜 (both already pair «японская слива» with the RU 梅 card's title term «японский абрикос», as that card's own note allows, and the consistency reviewer withdrew the item on recheck); and the comprehensibility reviewer's observations on 松 «Мацу», 横断, 検討, 欠席, 栄養, 構成, 機嫌 and 事情 (none was established as a defect; the kana and each card's paired gloss, context or an existing comparison card already carry the distinction). The optional comparison-entry IDs from the correctness review were adopted. No reviewer finding remains open.
